title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Lingayao, Municipality of Las Nieves, Province of Agusan Del Norte to Be Known as the Lingayao National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Lingayao, Municipality of Las Nieves, Province of Agusan Del Norte to Be Known as the Lingayao National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Lingayao, Thị trấn Las Nieves, Tỉnh Agusan Del Norte được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Lingayao
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Lingayao, เทศบาล Las Nieves, จังหวัด Agusan Del Norte ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Lingayao
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Lingayao, Kotamadya Las Nieves, Provinsi Agusan Del Norte dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Lingayao
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Lingayao, Perbandaran Las Nieves, Wilayah Agusan Del Norte dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Lingayao

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2001/ra_9056_2001.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Lingayao National High School is hereby established in Barangay Lingayao, Municipality of Las Nieves, Province of Agusan del Norte under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
